items.exampleEn: The circus tent was full of children.
items.exampleZh: 馬戲團的帳篷裡擠滿了孩子。

items.exampleEn: Hundreds of car enthusiasts came to see the old cars.
items.exampleZh: 好幾百位汽車迷來看那些老車。

items.exampleEn: Learning a new language can be enjoyable.
items.exampleZh: 學一種新語言可以很有樂趣。

items.exampleEn: Dogs are often afraid of fireworks.
The artist painted the old bridge in the rain.
items.exampleZh: 那位藝術家在雨中畫那座舊橋。

items.exampleEn: The actor gave a dramatic speech at the end.
items.exampleZh: 那位演員在最後發表了一段很有戲劇性的演說。

items.exampleEn: This tale has been told for hundreds of years.
items.exampleZh: 這個故事已經流傳了好幾百年。

items.exampleEn: The designer works from home three days a week.
items.exampleZh: 那位設計師每週在家工作三天。

items.sentenceEn: The fireworks started at exactly midnight.

items.audioEn: The circus starts at seven, but please come early to buy your tickets.
items.audioZh: 馬戲團七點開演，但請早點來買票。

items.sentenceEn: Reading literature helps you understand other people.
items.sentenceZh: 閱讀文學能幫助你了解別人。

items.sentenceEn: The designer chose bright colors for the new shop.
items.sentenceZh: 設計師為新店面選了鮮豔的顏色。

items.stemEn: Children love the clowns and animals at the ____.
items.stemZh: 孩子們喜歡馬戲團裡的小丑和動物。

items.stemEn: The film's ____ ending made everyone cry.
items.stemZh: 這部電影戲劇性的結局讓大家都哭了。

items.passageEn: My aunt is a circus enthusiast. Every year, she takes me to see the circus when it comes to our town. This year's show was especially dramatic. A young artist painted pictures while riding a horse, and a designer made amazing clothes for the show. The show ended with fireworks over the big tent. On the way home, my aunt told me an old tale about a circus elephant. It was a very enjoyable evening.
items.passageZh: 我阿姨是馬戲團迷。每年馬戲團來我們鎮上時，她都會帶我去看。今年的表演特別有戲劇性。一位年輕藝術家一邊騎馬一邊畫畫，一位設計師為表演做了很棒的服裝。表演最後，大帳篷上方放起了煙火。回家的路上，阿姨跟我講了一個關於馬戲團大象的老故事。那是一個非常愉快的晚上。

questions.questionZh: 今年的表演有什麼特別？
options: 一位藝術家邊騎馬邊畫畫

items.promptZh: 這個故事非常有戲劇性。
rubricZh: dramatic 表示「戲劇性的」，可放在 be 動詞後或名詞前，例如 a dramatic story 等
時態配合內容（多用現在簡單式）

items.instructionZh: 用 enjoyable 造一個句子，說說一次愉快的經驗。
referenceEn: My trip to the beach last summer was very enjoyable.
Cooking with my family is always enjoyable.
rubricZh: enjoyable 表示「令人愉快的」，例如 be enjoyable、an enjoyable trip 等說法
說的是自己的經驗（例如 I、my）
時態配合內容（例如說過去的事用過去式）
